action_mode: categorical raw logits/2 sampled at30Hz, four physical ticks held
baseline: Existing completed deterministic650 skill/fullmatch artifacts; never overwrite
finishing: Same64 initial finishing cases and12second limit per sampling seed; private RNG restarted from declared seed separately for each evaluation
full_matches: Same ten layouts/sides and fixed physics seed per sampling seed; 300second regulation plus existing bounded overtime; original corrected reset
inference: A changed action-selection diagnostic, NOT a same-method learning comparison. It cannot excuse failed deterministic performance or establish SSL
outcomes: Report all three seeds, per-case and aggregate goals/concedes/contacts. No seed/temperature search, no checkpoint selection, no promotion rule
stop: Complete finite diagnostic once. Preserve failures; no automatic learning/resume
unchanged: Model/Adam/checkpoint, reward/physics/Nexto, observations/actions, 30Hz/120Hz cadence, recurrent lifecycle; no actor or optimizer mutation
